gloss: to let one's guard down; to trust

definitions.gloss: to let one's guard down; to trust; to open up to
definitions.explanation: To relax one's caution toward someone and trust them, or to become careless.

examples.english: I trust him and can be myself with him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}を{許|ゆる}して⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't let your guard down with strangers so easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警戒|けいかい}していた→警戒する：25375_keikaisuru⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{気|き}を{許|ゆる}して⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: The cat was wary at first, but now it trusts me completely and sleeps on my lap.

notes:
USAGE:
Positive when said of a close relationship (⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}せる→許す：02325_yurusu⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧, a friend one can relax with); a warning in the negative ({気|き}を{許|ゆる}すな, "stay alert"). It can also mean relaxing too soon: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{気|き}を{許|ゆる}すな ("don't let up until the end").

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}せる→許す：02325_yurusu⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: someone one can be at ease with
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許|ゆる}す→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: to open one's heart (a close synonym)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}する→油断する：25389_yudansuru⟧: to be careless, off guard; always negative.
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open up emotionally.
